branch.text: W1.5 mutant: pre-dd25664 — the fallback keeps the cached pick without re-predicting

contract.text: The fallback re-predicts before delivery and delivers the refreshed selection; the cached pick is delivered only when the refresh fails or yields no pick.
contract.entry_mode: direct call of _refresh_pick_at_fallback (the compatibility wrapper over _refresh_pick_at_fallback_decision)
contract.trigger: the re-prediction (run_and_pick) selects a different batter from the cached pick
contract.symptom_kind: wrong value (the cached pick returned for delivery although the refresh selects another)

level_justification: the test replaces the prediction cascade run_and_pick (an internal collaborator: model tiers plus selection); the refresh helper, the heartbeat watchdog, provenance and save_pick run for real Lead's review: the entry _refresh_pick_at_fallback is a compatibility wrapper only tests call; run_day calls _refresh_pick_at_fallback_decision directly, whose FallbackRefreshResult is incomplete to the observer (Pick.flags at depth 3), so the wrapper's DailyPick return is the complete witness of the mutated decision's consequence.
